changes: Second archive pass independently validates path, type, size, duplicate and complete membership before writing each target; payload reads are bounded to the inventory size plus one overflow byte.
SIGTERM becomes KeyboardInterrupt only during proof publication; the previous handler is restored on success or failure; invalidated proof bytes are preserved under a unique name.
documentation: README was not edited in this repair; root made declared unrelated README updates.
limitations: Finite mutable sampling; no authentication or atomic concurrent-writer guarantee. On-Mac-only copies do not protect against disk failure.
scope: Tiny temporary Git/archive fixtures and owned Python signal children only; no full project backup, native job, network, or existing evidence mutation.
